reviews.comment: The professor is very kind, but the lectures can be a bit dull despite the material being interesting. The guest speakers were a highlight. Since the class is late in the day, many students lose focus. The workload is INCREDIBLY manageable and you can finish most assignments early and simply review for the final. Overall, an easy A.

dr. bell-pedersen is nice but she was rarely in a good mood. she'd call people out & yell at people trying to take pics of iclicker. hw/quizzes arent bad, but the final was closed book w/ lockdown browser. the class is HELLA curved so 80+ is an A, which is nice. tbh i wouldn't recommend this class bc she's probably just gonna get more strict

Don't listen to the other reviews, this class is still an easy A. 425/530 points is an A, which basically means if you do all the homework assignments and quizzes, as well as the iClicker you should have already have around 375 points. Dr. Bell-Pedersen is really nice and wants all students to get an A!

This class gotten harder and stricter with location locked iclicker and closed note exam. The material itself is very hard. Graduate level hard and very specific. Personally, i would avoid. Was once a good class to take, no longer.

She recently made her final closed note in person. However, those with accommodations get to take her final at home, so I'm not sure how that is fair. At times, it is hard to see the iClicker question on the board (especially if you are in the back), but whatever you do, DO NOT try to take a photo because she will YELL. Overall, she's nice.

Attendance is mandatory due to iClicker. She recently made her final exam in person, with closed notes. Her slides are hard to follow on your own, and her lectures are very boring and monotone. No longer an easy A, so take her class with caution. Quizzes and Perusall assignments are easy; just stay on top of them.

Quiz is take home. Iclicker is now location locked. Final exam is closed noted. The material itself is very specific and very hard. There are grad students in the course. She recently became stricter, no longer the easy class to take, avoid.
Lectures are extremely dry and monotone. Be careful: the final exam is now strictly CLOSED-NOTE.
She becomes stricter. No more open notes final. Final is closed notes. Beside that still the same. Just be aware

She is really caring and wants her students to succeed. 50pts - iClicker, 200pts -quizzes,100pts -perusal readings, and final at 150pts. 400/500pts is an A. Super easy. Only one exam as the final and it is open note. Quizzes are outside of class and easy. iClicker is the only thing that you can possibly lose points on. EASY A
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Pedersen was honestly my favorite prof I took this year. She was kind and really wanted her students to succeed, but that also means you have to put in a LOT of work to understand the material. Made a 66 on my first exam and a 98 on my last, so this class is difficult but definitely doable with 3 exams and a final paper. Overall a solid choice!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy
